resources.string: Enable to control edit mode via notification or Quick Settings tile
Block or modify any unwanted UI elements on any app - GodMode Pro
Show or hide app icon from launcher

1. Starting & Stopping Editor
 Settings → General → Master switch ON.
 In the target app:
• Notification: Tap to toggle Start/Exit Editor mode.
• Quick Settings Tile: One-tap toggle (alternative when notifs disabled).
• Disabling the master switch exits edit mode and removes the notification.

2. Tool Panel
 A semi-transparent panel appears on the right when editing:
• Slider — Select elements by hierarchy depth.
• Toggle Position — Panel left/right side.
• Remove / Modify — Expand respective menus.
• Feed Mode — Toggle Feed ON/OFF (default ON, see §4).
• Prev / Next — Navigate elements.
 Volume Keys: Press Vol Up/Down and release → toggle panel. When panel is open, volume keys navigate elements.
 Red overlay = selected element. Orange overlay = element inside a list (RecyclerView).

3. Selecting Elements
• Tap any element directly.
• Slider — Drag the vertical bar.
• Buttons — Tap Prev/Next on the panel.
• Volume keys — When panel is visible.

4. Feed Mode
 Tap the "Feed·ON/OFF" button on the panel:
• ON (default): Changes to list (RecyclerView) items apply to all structurally identical items.
• OFF: Each operation affects only the single selected element.

5. Remove Mode
 Tap "Remove" button to expand:
• Preview: Temporarily hide the element. Tap again to restore.
• Block (3 ways):
 1. Select → tap Block button on panel.
 2. Long-press element ~0.5s → green overlay + cancel zone at top → release outside cancel zone → particle burst → element gone.
 3. Long-press then drag to top green cancel zone → operation cancelled.
 Rules and screenshots saved automatically.

6. Modify Mode
 Tap "Modify" button to expand:

Property Panel
1. Select element → tap Modify button.
2. Adjust properties:
 • Width/Height — Slider or manual input (0~2000).
 • Alpha — 0~255 slider.
 • Position — Arrow keys, 10px per step.
 • Text — Edit TextView content.
 • Image — Pick gallery image for ImageView.
3. Tap Confirm to preview, Cancel to revert.
4. After all modifications done, tap Save button on the panel.
 Multiple elements can be modified before saving once.

Drag to Reposition
 In modify mode, long-press anywhere to drag the selected element (not the touched one):
• 16dp grid snap — Aligns to grid.
• 12dp edge snap — Snaps to sibling edges.
• Position auto-saved as a modify rule on release.

7. Rule Management
 Settings → App Rules:
• List: Tap a package. Menu filters: All / Remove / Modify.
• Details: Tap a rule → swipe left/right to browse screenshots, view info, depth, etc.
• Alias: Set a custom alias in details.
• Visibility: Toggle visible / invisible / gone in details.
• Delete:
 — Single: Details → menu → Delete.
 — Filtered: Filter first, then delete only that type.
 — All: All view → menu → Delete all (with confirmation).
 — Long-press a package in settings → clear all its rules at once.
• Backup:
 — Single: Details → menu → Backup.
 — Filtered/All: List → menu, exports current view.
• Restore: Settings → menu → select .gzip file.
 Backups include screenshots and images; rules take effect immediately after restore.

8. Notes
• Only works in third-party apps where the module is activated in LSPosed.
• Launcher, system UI, keyboard, GodMode Pro itself are not editable.
• After a crash, a dialog appears on next launch with a copyable log.
• Quick Settings tile works even when notifications are disabled.
